A full handoff names the exact resume steps (redeploy, re-confirm gate 21 from the deployed copy, finish the criterion-3 walk).

blockers.description: Phase 6's full verify-deploy.sh battery run (no --skip-slow) did not complete within this dispatch's bounded wait budget, due to a self-nesting verify-deploy.sh invocation inside gate 8's run-all.sh making the run far slower than its ~10 minute solo baseline. Resume with the full battery run (backgrounded, bounded kill-0 wait), then the deferred redeploy + criterion-3 confirmation. See the phase-6 handoff for the exact command and what NOT to try (do not start a second top-level battery; do not chase an unreachable all-green result, since gate 8's five known-red suites belong to other open tasks).
